LEADERSHIP_ENDORSEMENT.subject: Motorcycle Club Leadership Resource
LEADERSHIP_ENDORSEMENT.body: Respectfully reaching out because {{ORGANIZATION_NAME}} appears to value motorcycle club structure, leadership, and education. Black Dragon's Motorcycle Club Bible series was written as a practical library for clubs that want stronger prospect education, protocol, leadership development, and officer guidance. If useful, I would be glad to share more about how the books can support your members and leadership.

FOLLOW_UP.subject: Quick Follow-Up
FOLLOW_UP.body: Respectfully following up regarding Black Dragon's Motorcycle Club Bible series. The library was built to help motorcycle clubs strengthen prospect education, leadership, protocol, and officer development. If this is useful for {{ORGANIZATION_NAME}}, I would be glad to share more.
